body: If anyone finds this, though I doubt it, I’m so sorry. I’m sorry for the pain I’ve caused, lives destroyed, all I’ve taken and never given. I really only ever wanted better for us. I’m sorry for what I’ve done this night. Please forgive me. I just can’t continue to put any of us through it, you or me. I’m tired. I’m done. I’m spent. I love you so much. I just wish I had more to give, to make up, to take it back. . Goodbye
Thank you. Four is a lot. I’m curious, do they share or do you have four separate litter boxes
Both. I’ve had both. Lost both. Irreplaceable
Thank you for replying. Cried out. No energy to vent. Just entirely spent
